motion.name: wallet-action-state
motion.purpose: Existing white action hover/active transition; reduced-motion rules disable it.

components.name: Stablecoin and network choice
components.description: Native choices above submission; extracted from the public extension. Listed options are specimens, not a live availability claim.
components.html: Stablecoins are priced in USD. The amount is in US dollars.

components.name: Wallet action
components.description: White primary action for a wallet-prefilled transfer; the runtime fills the remaining amount.

components.name: Exact receipt rows
components.description: Expected and confirmed receipt stay separate, with a textual transaction result. Dashes are empty specimen values, not donations.

components.name: Transaction-ID recovery
components.description: Malformed-ID error specimen. Runtime submission focuses this described field; input clears its invalid state.
components.html: Invalid transaction ID format. Copy the complete transaction ID from your wallet or block explorer, then submit it again.
components.css: .ds-tx{background:var(--bg,#0b0b0b);color:var(--ink,#f5f5f5);font:14px/1.6 var(--sans,system-ui,sans-serif)}.ds-tx label{display:block;font-size:12px;margin:12px 0 8px}.ds-tx input{min-height:44px;min-width:0;max-width:100%;width:100%;padding:10px;border:1px solid #595959;border-radius:0;background:var(--bg,#0b0b0b);color:inherit;font:12px var(--mono,ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace)}.ds-tx p{margin:0 0 17px;font-size:13px;color:#fff;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-tx button{margin-top:12px;width:100%;min-height:48px;border:1px solid var(--line,#3f3f3f);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-tx button:hover{background:#202020}.ds-tx button:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.4}.ds-tx input:focus-visible,.ds-tx button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Admin network controls
components.description: Visible network/token switches, collapsed advanced JSON, and a per-network node/token check. Empty JSON specimen carries no configuration.
components.html: Advanced: nodes, contracts and finality
components.css: .ds-network{padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#333);background:var(--bg,#0b0b0b);color:var(--ink,#f5f5f5);font:14px/1.5 var(--sans,system-ui,sans-serif)}.ds-network label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px}.ds-network-enable{font-size:15px}.ds-network small{color:var(--muted,#aaa);font-size:12px;margin-left:6px}.ds-network input{width:18px;min-height:18px;margin:0;accent-color:var(--ink,#f5f5f5)}.ds-token-group{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;margin:12px 0 12px 28px}.ds-network details{margin:10px 0}.ds-network summary{cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;padding:10px 0;color:var(--muted,#aaa);font-size:12px;font-weight:500;list-style-position:outside}.ds-network details[open]>summary{margin-bottom:16px}.ds-network textarea{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--field-line,#555);border-radius:0;background:var(--bg,#0b0b0b);color:inherit;font:12px var(--mono,ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace);min-height:230px;resize:vertical}.ds-network textarea:hover{border-color:#888}.ds-network button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid var(--field-line,#555);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:500 13px/1.4 var(--sans,system-ui,sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s,border-color .15s}.ds-network button:hover{background:var(--surface,#151515);border-color:#999}.ds-network button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-network input:focus-visible,.ds-network summary:focus-visible,.ds-network textarea:focus-visible,.ds-network button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#f5f5f5);outline-offset:3px}.ds-network p{margin:8px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-network button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: The user pins the title Donate, an animated ASCII coffee logo, a black-and-white palette and minimal layouts. These explicit choices supersede the original token cloud and orbital art direction.
